mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stronger economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases sharply and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases sharply and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is increasing and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is decreasing, it indicates a strong economy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases.
